description: The current time in an IANA time zone (its UTC offset and whether DST applies) and, with time and to, the conversion of a local time from one zone to another. Computed in the Worker with the runtime's time zone data; no outside call. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
